cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a hangar maintenance bay — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her; a candlelit gala dinner hall — holds a cup in both hands; a narrow path through a tall bamboo grove — standing; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — standing; a present-day indoor bowling alley during a quiet practice hour — testing her legendary precision on a leisure game; the back seat of a taxi at night — touches one ear cup of a pair of over-ear headphones hung around her neck; the open deck of a wooden sightseeing boat on the Yangtze — standing; a private present-day sleeper-train compartment beside a large window — waking from a nap and reaching to close the window blind as the train enters a station; a walk-in closet with open shelves — standing; a scholar's study stacked with bound bamboo slips — standing; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — checks the photo on the back screen of a camera at chest height; a street food stall at night under a tarp — carries her keepsake low at her side; a traditional archery ground beside a temple wall — standing close to a high shelf or line
